dialect.detail: Likely GnuCOBOL or similar open-source COBOL with embedded SQL using JDBC-style connection string (Microsoft SQL Server JDBC driver), Dutch-language identifiers, file names suggest Belgian/Dutch educational context

purpose.domain_detail: Registration system for course/workshop participants (deelnemers = participants, leertraject = learning path), likely a student project for a Belgian/Dutch educational institution
purpose.summary: This program performs batch registration of users for courses and workshops. It reads a parameter file to get a JDBC connection string and project codes, validates project codes against a database, reads a CSV file of participants, generates passwords via a called subprogram, writes output CSV files, and inserts users into a SQL Server database. It also handles linking existing users to new learning path codes.

notable_features: EXEC SQL with JDBC-style CONNECT including DRIVER clause (non-standard SQL embedding)
SQL operations: SELECT, INSERT, COMMIT, DISCONNECT
CALL to external subprogram 'PWGenerator' for password generation
verdict.notes: The JDBC DRIVER clause in EXEC SQL CONNECT is non-standard and unusual; this may be a custom preprocessor or GnuCOBOL with a specific SQL extension. The program has several TODO items indicating incomplete features. Dutch-language naming and Belgian educational context strongly suggest a student project. The file is decoded as latin-1 which is consistent with Dutch text containing accented characters (e.g., geëncrypteerd). Duplicate declaration of JdbcString (once before and once inside DECLARE SECTION) is a potential bug.
